blocks.zh: 結果觀察、判讀與複試程序
blocks.en: Observation, Interpretation of Results and Retest Procedures

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 14 天培養期間的觀察要求與最終判讀標準
blocks.en: Understand the observation requirements during the 14-day incubation period and the criteria for the final reading

blocks.zh: 理解「無菌試驗合格」與「無菌試驗不合格」的正式判定邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the formal decision logic for "Sterility Test Passes" and "Sterility Test Fails"

blocks.zh: 掌握試驗無效（Invalid Test）的四項條件 — 唯一允許重試的前提
blocks.en: Master the four conditions for an invalid test, the only premise on which a repeat is allowed

blocks.zh: 理解複試（Retest）程序的規定與限制 — 只能重試一次
blocks.en: Understand the rules and limits of the retest procedure: a retest may be performed only once

blocks.zh: 認識假陽性調查（False Positive Investigation）的 CDMO 實務流程
blocks.en: Become familiar with the CDMO practice for a false positive investigation

blocks.zh: 了解注射劑、眼用製劑及其他非注射製劑的具體適用規定
blocks.en: Understand the specific provisions for parenteral, ophthalmic and other non-parenteral preparations

blocks.zh: 2.0 Observation & Interpretation of Results — 結果觀察與判讀
blocks.en: 2.0 Observation & Interpretation of Results

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 產品造成混濁的特殊處理
blocks.en: Special Handling When the Product Causes Turbidity

blocks.zh: 某些產品（例如懸浮液、乳劑、蛋白質製劑）加入培養基後會造成混濁，使得肉眼無法判斷是否有微生物生長。USP 的解決方案：
blocks.en: Some products (for example suspensions, emulsions and protein formulations) make the medium turbid once added, so that growth cannot be judged by eye. The USP solution is:

blocks.zh: 在第 14 天，從每管培養基中轉移至少 1 mL 到新的同種培養基
blocks.en: On day 14, transfer at least 1 mL from each vessel to a fresh vessel of the same medium

blocks.zh: 原管和新管都繼續培養至少 4 天
blocks.en: Continue incubating both the original and the new vessels for at least 4 days

blocks.zh: 在新管（沒有產品干擾）中觀察是否有微生物生長
blocks.en: Observe the new vessels (free of product interference) for microbial growth

blocks.zh: 這意味著對於混濁產品，總培養時間可能達到18 天（14 + 4），進一步延長批次放行時間。
blocks.en: This means that for turbid products the total incubation time can reach 18 days (14 + 4), further extending batch release time.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：渾水中的金魚
blocks.en: Analogy: The Goldfish in Murky Water

blocks.zh: 想像你在一個清水魚缸裡看有沒有金魚 — 一目了然。但如果水是渾濁的（產品造成的），你看不清楚。怎麼辦？
blocks.en: Imagine looking for a goldfish in a tank of clear water: it is obvious at a glance. But if the water is murky (because of the product), you cannot see. What do you do?

blocks.zh: USP 的方法是：舀一些渾水放到一個新的清水魚缸裡。如果渾水裡真的有魚（微生物），牠會在清水中繼續游動，很快就能被看到。如果清水中 4 天後仍然沒有魚，就可以確認原來的渾水裡也沒有。
blocks.en: The USP approach is to scoop some of the murky water into a new tank of clear water. If there really is a fish (microorganism) in the murky water, it will keep swimming in the clear water and will soon be seen. If there is still no fish in the clear water after 4 days, you can be confident that the original murky water has none either.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的觀察時間表
blocks.en: CDMO Observation Schedule

blocks.zh: USP 要求「在培養期間的間隔時間」進行觀察。CDMO 的最佳實務是建立明確的觀察時間表：
blocks.en: USP requires observation "at intervals during the incubation period". The CDMO best practice is to establish a clear observation schedule:

blocks.zh: Day 3–5：首次觀察 — 快速生長的細菌可能已經可見
blocks.en: Day 3-5: First observation. Fast-growing bacteria may already be visible

blocks.zh: Day 7：中期觀察 — 大多數細菌應該可見
blocks.en: Day 7: Mid-point observation. Most bacteria should be visible

blocks.zh: Day 10–11：後期觀察 — 慢速生長菌和真菌
blocks.en: Day 10-11: Late observation. Slow-growing bacteria and fungi

blocks.zh: Day 14：最終判讀 — 正式結果記錄
blocks.en: Day 14: Final reading. Formal result recorded

blocks.zh: 每次觀察都必須記錄在實驗室紀錄中，包括觀察者簽名、觀察結果、培養基外觀描述。
blocks.en: Every observation must be recorded in the laboratory records, including the observer signature, the observation result and a description of the medium appearance.

blocks.zh: 判讀邏輯：簡單但影響巨大
blocks.en: Interpretation Logic: Simple but High-Impact

blocks.zh: USP ⟨71⟩ 的結果判讀看似簡單，實際上每一個字都牽涉到數百萬元的批次放行或拒放決策：
blocks.en: The interpretation of results in USP ⟨71⟩ looks simple, but every word bears on a batch release or rejection decision worth millions:

blocks.zh: 關鍵字是「macroscopic evidence」— 肉眼可見的證據。這包括：培養基混濁、菌膜形成、培養基顏色變化、沉澱物等。
blocks.en: The key phrase is "macroscopic evidence", meaning evidence visible to the naked eye. This includes medium turbidity, pellicle formation, color change of the medium, sediment and so on.

blocks.zh: 2.1 Invalid Test & Retest Procedures — 試驗無效條件與複試程序
blocks.en: 2.1 Invalid Test & Retest Procedures

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：法庭的「無效審判」
blocks.en: Analogy: A "Mistrial" in Court

blocks.zh: 把無菌試驗想成一場審判。「有罪」（不合格）的判決一旦做出，只有在能證明審判程序本身有瑕疵（而不是被告的問題）時，才能宣告「無效審判」並重審。
blocks.en: Think of the sterility test as a trial. Once a "guilty" (fail) verdict has been reached, a "mistrial" can be declared and the case retried only if you can show that the trial procedure itself was flawed (not that something was wrong with the defendant).

blocks.zh: 你不能因為不喜歡判決結果就要求重審 — 必須有具體的程序瑕疵證據。同樣，你不能因為無菌試驗不合格就直接重做 — 必須有上述四項條件之一的明確證據。
blocks.en: You cannot ask for a retrial just because you dislike the verdict. You need specific evidence of a procedural flaw. Likewise, you cannot simply repeat a failed sterility test; you need clear evidence of one of the four conditions above.

blocks.zh: 第 4 項條件 — 最具爭議也最常被援引
blocks.en: Condition 4: The Most Contested and Most Frequently Invoked

blocks.zh: 第 4 項（「unequivocally ascribed to faults」）是實務中最常被使用、但也最容易被法規稽查員質疑的條件。
blocks.en: Condition 4 ("unequivocally ascribed to faults") is the condition most often used in practice, and also the one regulatory inspectors most readily challenge.

blocks.zh: 關鍵字是 "unequivocally"（明確無疑地）：
blocks.en: The key word is "unequivocally":

blocks.zh: 你必須鑑定污染微生物的種屬（Species Identification）
blocks.en: You must identify the species of the contaminating microorganism (species identification)

blocks.zh: 你必須證明該菌種明確來自試驗操作/環境而非產品
blocks.en: You must demonstrate that the organism clearly originated from the test operation or environment and not from the product

blocks.zh: 你需要與歷史環境監控數據交叉比對
blocks.en: You need to cross-check against historical environmental monitoring data

blocks.zh: 如果鑑定出的菌種是人體皮膚菌（如 Staphylococcus epidermidis），但你的製程是人員密集操作的無菌充填 — 就很難「明確無疑地」排除它來自產品污染
blocks.en: If the isolate is a human skin organism (such as Staphylococcus epidermidis) and your process is a personnel-intensive aseptic filling operation, it is very hard to rule out product contamination "unequivocally"

blocks.zh: 複試規則：只有一次機會
blocks.en: Retest Rules: Only One Chance

blocks.zh: USP 的複試規則極為嚴格：
blocks.en: The USP retest rules are extremely strict:

blocks.zh: 複試取樣量 = 原始試驗取樣量（不能減少）
blocks.en: Retest sample size = original test sample size (it cannot be reduced)

blocks.zh: 只能重試一次 — 沒有第三次機會
blocks.en: The test may be repeated only once, with no third chance

blocks.zh: 複試合格 → 通過
blocks.en: Retest passes: the product complies

blocks.zh: 複試不合格 → 不通過（最終判定）
blocks.en: Retest fails: the product does not comply (final decision)

blocks.zh: 這意味著對 CDMO 而言，一旦初試出現陽性結果，壓力巨大 — 你必須在宣告無效和接受不合格之間做出有據可依的決定，而且複試只有一次機會。
blocks.en: This means that for a CDMO, a positive result in the initial test creates enormous pressure: you must make a well-founded decision between declaring the test invalid and accepting the failure, and you have only one chance at a retest.

blocks.zh: CDMO 假陽性調查（False Positive Investigation）標準流程
blocks.en: CDMO Standard Process for a False Positive Investigation

blocks.zh: 當無菌試驗出現陽性結果時，CDMO 的標準調查流程：
blocks.en: When a sterility test gives a positive result, the standard CDMO investigation process is:

blocks.zh: 立即隔離批次 — 暫停放行，進入調查狀態
blocks.en: Quarantine the batch immediately: suspend release and place it under investigation

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定 — 將陽性培養基中的微生物進行種屬鑑定（16S rRNA 序列分析或自動化鑑定系統）
blocks.en: Microbial identification: identify the microorganism from the positive medium to species level (16S rRNA sequencing or an automated identification system)

blocks.zh: 環境監控數據審查 — 調閱試驗當天及前後數天的環境監控數據（沉降菌、浮游菌、表面微生物）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring data review: pull the environmental monitoring data for the test day and several days before and after (settle plates, active air, surface monitoring)

blocks.zh: 操作紀錄審查 — 檢查試驗員的操作紀錄、培養基批號、設備校驗紀錄
blocks.en: Operating record review: check the analyst operating records, medium lot numbers and equipment calibration records

blocks.zh: 陰性對照確認 — 確認同批試驗的陰性對照是否合格
blocks.en: Negative control confirmation: confirm that the negative controls of the same test run were acceptable

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析 — 該產品或該試驗室的歷史陽性率是否異常
blocks.en: Trend analysis: determine whether the historical positive rate for the product or the laboratory is abnormal

blocks.zh: 綜合判定 — 依據上述證據決定：宣告無效並複試 OR 判定不合格
blocks.en: Overall determination: based on the above evidence, decide whether to declare the test invalid and retest OR to declare a failure

blocks.zh: CAPA — 無論結果如何，都要建立矯正預防措施
blocks.en: CAPA: raise corrective and preventive actions regardless of the outcome

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 一批高價值生物製劑（價值 500 萬美元）在第 7 天的無菌試驗中出現一管 FTM 混濁。微生物鑑定為 Staphylococcus epidermidis。陰性對照全部合格，環境監控數據正常。你會如何決定？能否引用第 4 項條件宣告無效？
blocks.en: A high-value biologic batch at your CDMO (worth USD 5 million) shows one turbid FTM vessel in the day 7 sterility test. The organism is identified as Staphylococcus epidermidis. All negative controls are acceptable and the environmental monitoring data are normal. How would you decide? Can you invoke condition 4 to declare the test invalid?

blocks.zh: 如果同一產品的複試在第 12 天也出現一管 SCDM 有 Aspergillus 生長，但這次的菌種與初試不同，這代表什麼？
blocks.en: If the retest of the same product shows Aspergillus growth in one SCDM vessel on day 12, but the species differs from the initial test, what does this mean?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 只允許重試「一次」而不是「直到通過為止」？這背後的統計學和法規邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does USP allow a retest only "once" rather than "until it passes"? What are the statistical and regulatory rationales behind this?

blocks.zh: 四項無效條件 — 逐一解析
blocks.en: The Four Invalidity Conditions, One by One

blocks.zh: 這四項條件是 USP 允許宣告無菌試驗無效並進行複試的唯一合法依據。任何不符合這四項的陽性結果，都必須判定為不合格：
blocks.en: These four conditions are the only legitimate grounds on which USP allows a sterility test to be declared invalid and repeated. Any positive result that does not meet one of these four conditions must be judged a failure:

blocks.zh: 2.2 Application to Parenteral, Ophthalmic & Other Preparations — 特定製劑的適用規定
blocks.en: 2.2 Application to Parenteral, Ophthalmic & Other Preparations

blocks.zh: 「同一樣品」原則的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of the "Same Sample" Principle

blocks.zh: USP 明確要求細菌和真菌的無菌試驗必須在同一樣品上進行。這意味著：
blocks.en: USP explicitly requires that the sterility tests for bacteria and fungi be performed on the same sample. This means:

blocks.zh: 同一瓶（或同一組瓶）的內容物要分給 FTM 和 SCDM
blocks.en: The contents of the same container (or the same set of containers) must be divided between FTM and SCDM

blocks.zh: 不能用不同的瓶子分別測試細菌和真菌
blocks.en: Different containers may not be used to test for bacteria and fungi separately

blocks.zh: 如果一瓶的量不夠分給兩種培養基，可以合併多瓶的內容物
blocks.en: If the volume in one container is not enough for both media, the contents of several containers may be pooled

blocks.zh: 為什麼？因為如果用不同的瓶子，可能一瓶被污染但另一瓶沒有。使用同一樣品確保兩種試驗面對的是完全相同的微生物學狀態。
blocks.en: Why? If different containers were used, one might be contaminated while the other is not. Using the same sample ensures that both tests face exactly the same microbiological status.

blocks.zh: 膜過濾法：「盡可能使用全部內容物」
blocks.en: Membrane Filtration: "Whenever Possible, the Whole Contents"

blocks.zh: USP 對膜過濾法有一個微妙但重要的措辭：「whenever possible, the whole contents」。這意味著：
blocks.en: USP uses a subtle but important wording for membrane filtration: "whenever possible, the whole contents". This means:

blocks.zh: 如果技術可行，應該將容器的全部內容物過濾通過濾膜
blocks.en: If technically feasible, the entire contents of the container should be filtered through the membrane

blocks.zh: Table 2 的量是最低要求（minimum），不是目標值
blocks.en: The quantities in Table 2 are the minimum requirement, not a target

blocks.zh: 使用全部內容物可以最大化微生物的偵測概率
blocks.en: Using the entire contents maximizes the probability of detecting microorganisms

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實務中，對於小容量注射劑（1–5 mL），通常可以全量使用。對於大容量產品（100+ mL），則按 Table 2 取最低量即可。
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, for small-volume injectables (1-5 mL) the whole volume can usually be used. For large-volume products (100+ mL), taking the minimum quantity per Table 2 is sufficient.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 在 6 個月內連續出現 3 次無菌試驗假陽性（全部經調查後宣告無效），即使每次複試都合格，法規稽查員可能會提出什麼質疑？
blocks.en: If your CDMO has 3 consecutive false positive sterility tests within 6 months (all declared invalid after investigation), what might a regulatory inspector question even if every retest passed?

blocks.zh: 一批 0.5 mL 預充式注射器（批量 3,000 支），根據 Table 2 和 Table 3，你需要抽多少支？每支取多少量？如果內容物不夠分給兩種培養基，怎麼辦？
blocks.en: For a batch of 0.5 mL prefilled syringes (batch size 3,000 units), how many units must you test according to Table 2 and Table 3, and what quantity from each? What if the contents are not enough for both media?

blocks.zh: 與 Media Fill 的交叉對照
blocks.en: Cross-Reference with Media Fill

blocks.zh: USP ⟨71⟩ 的無菌試驗與無菌製程模擬（Media Fill / APS）之間有密切的關聯，但它們是不同的東西：
blocks.en: The USP ⟨71⟩ sterility test and the aseptic process simulation (media fill / APS) are closely related, but they are different things:

blocks.zh: 兩者互相支持：Media Fill 驗證製程能力，USP ⟨71⟩ 驗證每批產品的最終狀態。
blocks.en: The two support each other: media fill verifies process capability, while USP ⟨71⟩ verifies the final state of each batch.

blocks.zh: 2.3 Sterility Test Decision Flowchart — 無菌試驗決策流程圖
blocks.en: 2.3 Sterility Test Decision Flowchart

blocks.zh: 決策流程的關鍵分支點
blocks.en: Key Branch Points in the Decision Flow

blocks.zh: 整個 USP ⟨71⟩ 的邏輯可以歸結為三個關鍵分支點：
blocks.en: The whole logic of USP ⟨71⟩ can be summarized in three key branch points:

blocks.zh: Day 14 判讀：有生長 vs 無生長
blocks.en: Day 14 reading: growth vs no growth

blocks.zh: 無效性評估：四項條件是否至少符合一項
blocks.en: Invalidity assessment: whether at least one of the four conditions is met

blocks.zh: 複試結果：第二次（也是最後一次）機會
blocks.en: Retest result: the second (and final) chance

blocks.zh: 每個分支點的決定都必須有書面文件支持，且需要品質保證部門（QA）的正式核准。
blocks.en: The decision at each branch point must be supported by written documentation and requires formal approval by Quality Assurance (QA).

blocks.zh: 法規稽查員的重點關注
blocks.en: Key Focus Areas for Regulatory Inspectors

blocks.zh: FDA 和其他法規機構在稽查無菌試驗時，特別關注：
blocks.en: When inspecting sterility testing, FDA and other regulators pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 陽性率趨勢：如果你的實驗室陽性率持續偏高（例如 > 1%），代表系統性問題
blocks.en: Positive rate trend: a consistently high positive rate in your laboratory (for example > 1%) indicates a systemic problem

blocks.zh: 無效宣告頻率：頻繁宣告無效 = 可能在「test into compliance」（反覆測試直到合格）
blocks.en: Frequency of invalidation: frequent invalidation = possible "testing into compliance" (repeating tests until they pass)

blocks.zh: 調查品質：第 4 項條件的引用是否有充分的微生物學證據支持
blocks.en: Quality of the investigation: whether the use of condition 4 is backed by sufficient microbiological evidence

blocks.zh: 複試成功率：如果複試總是合格，稽查員會質疑初試的問題是否真的被解決
blocks.en: Retest success rate: if retests always pass, inspectors will question whether the problem in the initial test was really resolved

blocks.zh: CAPA 有效性：類似問題是否反覆發生，矯正措施是否到位
blocks.en: CAPA effectiveness: whether similar problems recur and whether corrective actions are in place

blocks.zh: 綜合練習：CDMO 無菌試驗情境模擬
blocks.en: Integrated Exercise: CDMO Sterility Test Scenario

blocks.zh: 情境：你的 CDMO 正在為一家歐洲客戶充填一批單株抗體注射劑（批量 2,000 瓶，每瓶 10 mL，價值 800 萬美元）。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO is filling a batch of monoclonal antibody injection for a European client (batch size 2,000 vials, 10 mL per vial, worth USD 8 million).

blocks.zh: 根據 Table 3，你需要取多少瓶做無菌試驗？
blocks.en: According to Table 3, how many vials do you need to take for the sterility test?

blocks.zh: 根據 Table 2，每瓶取多少 mL？
blocks.en: According to Table 2, how many mL do you take from each vial?

blocks.zh: 你選擇膜過濾法。在第 9 天，一管 SCDM 出現混濁。陰性對照全部清澈。你的即時行動是什麼？
blocks.en: You choose membrane filtration. On day 9, one SCDM vessel becomes turbid. All negative controls are clear. What is your immediate action?

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定結果為 Bacillus cereus。環境監控數據在試驗當天有一個沉降菌皿超標（> 1 cfu in Grade A）。你能引用哪項無效條件？
blocks.en: The organism is identified as Bacillus cereus. The environmental monitoring data show one settle plate exceeding the limit on the test day (> 1 cfu in Grade A). Which invalidity condition can you invoke?

blocks.zh: 如果你宣告無效並複試，複試在 Day 14 全部合格，你可以放行這批產品嗎？你會向客戶如何解釋整個過程？
blocks.en: If you declare the test invalid and retest, and the retest is fully acceptable on day 14, can you release the batch? How would you explain the whole process to the client?

blocks.zh: CDMO 的時間壓力與風險管理
blocks.en: CDMO Time Pressure and Risk Management

blocks.zh: 在整個流程中，時間是最大的壓力來源：
blocks.en: Throughout the process, time is the greatest source of pressure:

blocks.zh: 如果發生陽性 + 調查 + 複試的完整流程，批次放行可能延遲到充填後第 5 週以上。這對產品穩定性、客戶交貨時程、倉儲成本都是巨大的影響。
blocks.en: If the full sequence of positive result + investigation + retest occurs, batch release may be delayed to week 5 or later after filling. This has a major impact on product stability, client delivery schedules and storage costs.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 結果判讀：14 天無生長 = 合格（PASS）；出現生長 = 不合格（FAIL），除非能證明試驗無效
blocks.en: Interpretation of results: no growth at 14 days = PASS; growth = FAIL, unless the test can be shown to be invalid

blocks.zh: 混濁產品處理：第 14 天轉移 ≥ 1 mL 到新培養基，再培養 ≥ 4 天 — 總培養時間可達 18 天
blocks.en: Handling of turbid products: on day 14 transfer ≥ 1 mL to fresh medium and incubate for a further ≥ 4 days; total incubation can reach 18 days

blocks.zh: 四項無效條件（唯一）：(1) 環境監控異常 (2) 操作程序缺失 (3) 陰性對照生長 (4) 污染菌明確歸因於試驗缺失
blocks.en: Four invalidity conditions (the only ones): (1) environmental monitoring abnormality (2) lapse in operating procedure (3) growth in the negative control (4) contaminating organism unequivocally ascribed to a testing fault

blocks.zh: 複試規則：只能重試一次，取樣量與原試驗相同 — 複試合格則通過，不合格則最終拒放
blocks.en: Retest rules: only one retest, with the same sample size as the original test; if the retest passes the product complies, if it fails the batch is finally rejected

blocks.zh: 同一樣品原則：細菌（FTM）和真菌（SCDM）試驗必須使用同一樣品的內容物
blocks.en: Same sample principle: the bacterial (FTM) and fungal (SCDM) tests must use contents from the same sample

blocks.zh: CDMO 時間影響：正常流程 14 天放行；如發生陽性 + 調查 + 複試，可能延遲到第 5 週以上
blocks.en: CDMO time impact: release at 14 days in the normal flow; positive result + investigation + retest may delay release to week 5 or later

blocks.zh: 假陽性調查核心：微生物鑑定 + 環境監控數據交叉比對 + 操作紀錄審查 — 證據必須「明確無疑」
blocks.en: Core of a false positive investigation: microbial identification + cross-check against environmental monitoring data + review of operating records; the evidence must be "unequivocal"

blocks.zh: 法規關注焦點：陽性率趨勢、無效宣告頻率、調查品質、CAPA 有效性 — 避免「test into compliance」的嫌疑
blocks.en: Regulatory focus: positive rate trend, frequency of invalidation, quality of investigation and CAPA effectiveness; avoid any suspicion of "testing into compliance"
